reasoning: Keep for every source prefix the longest target prefix representable with at most k pieces. Starting a new piece at each source position extends that prefix by the exact LCP of source and target suffixes. A shorter matched prefix cannot give a better global transition: if its extension overtakes the longer prefix, discard the redundant leading characters and start that same piece later. Propagate maxima from left to right for each layer. Exact suffix-array doubling, Kasai LCP and sparse-table RMQ avoid hash collisions. Before preprocessing, handle one-piece success and reject targets that are not even subsequences. O((n+m)log(n+m)+limit*n) time, no guessed match lengths.
public_fix: Compress initial byte ranks into 0..alphabet_size-1 before packing rank pairs in base length+1; otherwise byte values exceed radix for short strings. Reset Kasai carried match at rank zero.
